ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:15; high-intensity (white) pixels are strictly localized to the distal trailing edge margins, occupying approximately 8% of the visible surface, against a 92% low-intensity (dark) field.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Symmetrical high-intensity contiguous banding along the distal trailing edges of both lobes; high-contrast focal spots mapped to the extreme lateral tips of the fluke structure.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 68 degrees and a vertical depth relative to lobe height of roughly 18%.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency jagged variations (peaks and valleys) with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels; serration density is highest at the lateral lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory following an upward and outward parabolic curve from the median notch vertex to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the extreme outer corners (distal tips) of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel light-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the mid-ventral surface of the left lobe; fainter, similar marks detected on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular notch and jagged material loss at the extreme lateral tip of the left lobe; dense white scarring mapped to the peripheral boundary of the trailing edge.
